BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chieago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RS 1 Residential Single-Unit

(Detached House) District symbols as shown on Map No. 13-G

in the area bounded by:



A line 114.00 feet north ofand parallel to West Castlewood Terrace; a line 650.00 feet

east and parallel to North Sheridan Road; West Castlewood Terrace; and a line 600.00

feet east of and parallel to North Sheridan Road;



To those of a RT 4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.




SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common address of property: 854 West Castlewood Terrace, Chicago
 Narrative and Pians for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for 854 West Castlewood Terrace, Chicago

Project Description: The subject property is presently improved with an old, vacant single family home.
The applicants have applied for a building permit for an interior renovation and a new addition which
exceeds the floor area allowance.

The applicants seek a zoning change from an RS 1 District to an RT 4 district in order to meet the buik
and density requirements of the RT 4 district to allow the increase of the FAR for a building addition to
the existing single family residence building.

    A) Proposed land use: Single family home.
    B) The project's floor area ratio: 1.03.
    C) The project's density (lot area per dwelling unit): 5,700 square feet of lot area for one dwelling
       unit.
    D) The amount of off-street parking: 2 parking spaces.
    E) Setbacks:
       Front setback: 25.5 feet.             i
       Rear setback: 0.0 feet
       West side setback: 2.1 feet.
       East side setback: 12.83 feet
    F) Building height: 34 feet-4 inches (existing)
